svg.title: States of a voucher
svg.desc: A voucher starts as a draft, then evidence check, approval, ready, posted in GFMIS, paid and reconciled. Non-budget money skips GFMIS. The maker can recall it, the checker and the approver can return it, and rejected and cancelled are final.
